---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a capability the engine does not have
title: "feature: "
labels: enhancement
---

## The problem

What you were trying to do, and where the engine got in the way. Lead with the
problem rather than the solution — the shape of the fix is usually the second
question.

## What you do today

The workaround, if you have one.

## What you had in mind

Optional. If you have a specific design, describe it; if not, the problem
statement above is enough to start from.

## Scope

Is this something you would use once, or something you would depend on?
